|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Alert My Star Destroyer! (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Original)|Original]] and [[Alert My Star Destroyer! (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original slip and the [[:File:SE-D-alertmystardestroyer-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] have no title dot. The remastered slip prints a dot. The period rule retains the restriction of the underlying card, and the source documents the printed mark. The simultaneous-deployment rule requires the pilot to deploy aboard its matching ship. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=45 Simultaneous deployment]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=95 Inherited restriction on virtual cards].
